title: Trip: ground delay program at the destination (MSP→ORD)
description: A calendar trip MSP→ORD departing in 90 minutes while ORD has a ground delay program: flights to ORD are held at MSP, so the trip shows Delays likely.

assert.re: ^ORD ground delay program: flights to ORD are held — your .+ MSP→ORD departure may wait ~45 min\.$

blurb: MSP→ORD while ORD has a ground delay program.
